note: World Series publish anomaly watcher (apps/observer/ops/ws_alert.py). Every threshold here is still PROVISIONAL (n = 1 game, 849817 first live rehearsal 2026-10-18, F-rehearsal RESULT.json + RESULT-REVIEW-001; runbook section 3.1 holds the per-rule reasoning). Only file_stuck_s was changed by it (300 -> 450, runbook 3.1); the others were kept. Paths are never inside the repository; null = taken from env or CLI (see the runbook section 7).

paths.out_dir_note: Publisher output folder (the one holding v1/). null = --out or env PITCHEEZY_PUBLISH_OUT_DIR.
paths.state_path_note: Publisher state file. null = env PITCHEEZY_PUBLISH_STATE, else '<out_dir>.state.json' (the publisher's own default). Must match the publisher's actual state_path: rehearsal folders use publisher.state.json.
paths.ops_status_note: Operations supervisor status (pitcheezy-ws-ops-status-v1, docs/pm/service/ws-ops-status-contract.md). Env PITCHEEZY_WS_OPS_ROOT (<root>/status.json), PITCHEEZY_WS_OPS_STATUS or --ops-status overrides; a missing file is simply not read.
paths.alert_dir_note: Watcher state (alert_state.json) and the append-only alerts.jsonl. Env PITCHEEZY_ALERT_DIR or --alert-dir overrides.
paths.disk_paths_note: Free space is checked on each of these and on the output folder's parent.

game_window.note: A game is 'in window' from start-before_start_s until it is final, or at most start+max_game_s. Sources: the publisher's games/<KST date>.json (yesterday..tomorrow), the ops status file, and schedule below.

schedule_provisional_note: provisional — update when MLB confirms. These World Series games (gameType W) come from the saved MLB schedule of 2026-10-17/18 whose times are all the 00:00:00Z placeholder (startTimeTBD false but not real first-pitch times). Windows around a wrong time are harmless (quiet outside windows) but a real game outside the window would be missed unless the publisher or ops status lists it, so replace the times when MLB confirms. See runbook section 7.1.
schedule_note: Manual fallback when the publisher has not listed the game: [{"game_pk": 123, "start": "2026-10-24T00:08:00Z"}].
thresholds_note: Runbook section 3: health stall 30 s (3 cycles), feed_ok false > 60 s, lag > 45 s, blocked at once, disk floor 12.5 GiB (the refresh skips near 12 GiB), profile ok by 21:20 KST. Watcher-only choices: publisher_down 120 s (health stalled; at once), publisher_down_hold_s 30 (no health.json yet or publisher.running false while the launcher is not in backoff/failed/refused/stopped: the window opens the moment the launcher starts the publisher, OPS-02 drill + PM decision 2026-10-19; those four states still fire at once), file_stuck 450 s (was 300: the 849817 rehearsal had a 330 s run of live cycles with no game-file write, so 300 could fire on a healthy game, see runbook 3.1; a live game normally changes within a few minutes; between-inning breaks are about 2-3 minutes), upload_pending = above 5 and not decreasing over 4 publish cycles and upload_stalled = oldest queued intent unchanged > 60 s (background upload keeps 2-3 pending every cycle and sets upload.code whenever pending > 0, so neither is an error by itself; REVIEW-001 B1), ops status stale 90 s running/backoff, 300 s otherwise (launcher heartbeat 10 s running / 60 s waiting), memory 2 GiB (kept: rehearsal available_min was 7.56 GB; RS-01 stops itself earlier, at its own 2048-3072 MB floor) from vm_stat free+inactive+speculative (an approximation, not the memory pressure colour).

notify.note: A condition notifies once when it starts (after its hold), again every renotify_s while it lasts (renotify_outside_game_s when no game is in window), and once when it clears. After clearing, the same key does not notify again for cooldown_s (flapping).

game_gated_note: Families evaluated only while a game is in window (quiet otherwise). Always on: upload_blocked / upload_conflict / upload_unknown / upload_rejected (they never clear by themselves), state_unreadable, disk_low, profile_refresh, ops_state, ops_problem, ops_status_stale (the supervisor also runs while waiting), watch_config, input_malformed (an input that is valid JSON but not an object; OPS-ALERT-JSON01). All upload rules are skipped while health.upload.dry_run is true.
